chain.label: FAA denied SLC request for additional runway wind sensors
chain.trigger: in November 2015, SLC ATC management requested ... install five additional wind sensors ... the request was denied in April 2016 for budgetary reasons

chain.label: Known thunderstorm/convective activity in the SLC area
chain.trigger: Thunderstorms were forecast for SLC in several different weather forecast products, including a terminal aerodrome forecast ... and a convective SIGMET ... valid for the accident site

chain.label: Tower disseminated only 16-kt center-field wind; 48-kt ASOS gusts and microburst not detected or relayed
chain.trigger: the ATC tower at SLC reported a wind gust of 16 knots ... However, the airport's ASOS ... reported wind between 25 and 29 knots with gusts to 48 knots. ATC and the wind shear detection system did not have access to the ASOS wind information, and the pilot was not aware of it

caused_by.evidence: an inadequate amount of wind sensors and wind shear detection equipment used by the air traffic control (ATC) tower to detect microburst activity at the airport

caused_by.evidence: Rain showers and convective clouds can produce downdrafts, outflow boundaries, and gust fronts ... which can create an environment favorable for unexpected changes in surface wind direction and speed
